description:
External PR https://github.com/Stage-11-Agentics/c11/pull/212 (author BenevolentFutures, 2026-05-26, single commit) adds Grok Build as a built-in agent type. Operator has CLEARED IT TO MERGE (2026-06-12) pending deep review + rebase.

State: CONFLICTING with main. The agent-registry surface moved since May: conversation store landed in 0.44 as the resume path; AgentRestartRegistry is deprecated (removal scheduled 0.46) and this PR patches it — the rebase must wire the new agent into the conversation-store era, not the deprecated rail. C11-131 (just merged, PR #239) also touched crash-resume in this area.

Files: CLI/c11.swift, AgentChip, AgentDetector, AgentRestartRegistry, AgentSkillsView, DefaultAgentConfig, SkillInstaller, SurfaceMetadataStore, c11Tests/DefaultAgentConfigTests, docs/adding-a-new-agent.md, skills/c11/SKILL.md + references/api.md.

Acceptance: deep code review recorded; rebased onto current main preserving contributor authorship in commit metadata; builds green; c11-logic suite green; skills updated AND scripts/sync-installed-skills.sh run if skills touched; localization pass for any user-facing strings; merged; PR comment crediting the contributor. Merge BEFORE C11-137 (#215) — oldest first; the second PR re-rebases over this one.

Related: C11-137 (PR #215, same files, same delegator thread).
title: Land PR #212: Grok Build as built-in agent type (rebase + deep review + merge)
